overview_description.description:
HoloFair, is a one-of-a-kind 3D virtual events platform where users across the globe can connect with one another in the digital world. With HoloFair, event organizers are no longer restricted to physical events. They are able to host virtual exhibitions, conferences, career fairs or any custom event they require. Real-life events can even be supplemented with virtual events, forming a hybrid event!

Outreal XR has ensured an unforgettable 3D experience for users, from networking tools to virtual walkthrough.

What makes HoloFair the most advanced virtual events platform?
- Available on web browser and mobile application
- Multi-user online system where real people interact in real-time
- Users walk and move around as personalized avatars
- Extremely realistic 3D environment
- Completely customizable
- Able to integrate gamification and e-commerce features
- Able to incorporate digital collateral, forms, surveys, polls, and more
- Able to record insightful data and metrics regarding users
